name: elagoht/consent
description: A collage plugin with a cookie-consent banner, a gate that holds scripts and iframes back until their category is granted, and a JS API.

config.description: A collage plugin with a cookie-consent banner, a gate that holds scripts and iframes back until their category is granted, and a JS API.

categories.description: Categories are the kinds of processing; at least one is required.

name.description: Name is the category's name, matching ^[a-z0-9-]+$: what data-consent names.

required.description: Required marks a category that is always granted and has no switch.

maxAgeDays.description: MaxAgeDays is how long the choice is remembered, 1 to 400. Default 180.

policyURL.description: PolicyURL links the banner to the privacy policy.

serverPaths.description: ServerPaths are the paths where the server may read the choice with Granted, by whole segments: "/shop" covers "/shop/x", never "/shopping". Responses there carry Vary: Cookie.

text.description: Text is the wording per locale; the default locale must be present.

accept.description: Accept is the label of the button granting every category.

allow.description: Allow is the placeholder's grant label; {category} is the category's label.

categories.description: Categories are each category's label, by name.

placeholder.description: Placeholder stands before a held-back iframe; {host} is its host.

policy.description: Policy is the policy link's text; without it the link reads as PolicyURL.

reject.description: Reject is the label of the button refusing every optional category.

save.description: Save is the label of the button saving the ticked categories.

settings.description: Settings is the label of the button showing one checkbox per category.

version.description: Version is bumped to ask every visitor again. Default 1.
